create_constant_tensor: create a cached constant PyTorch tensor from a value with optional shape, dtype, and device
test_assert_shape: test that a PyTorch tensor matches a reference shape with symbolic assertion support
build_infinite_sampler: build an InfiniteSampler for DataLoader that loops over a dataset indefinitely with shuffling
review_print_module_summary: review a PyTorch module hierarchy and print a summary table of parameters, buffers, and output shapes
run_cuda_time: run a code block and measure its GPU execution time in milliseconds using CUDA events
